title: Janet flights from McCarran to Area 51
place_text: McCarran Airport, Las Vegas to Area 51, Nevada

tellings.quote: I'd drive out to EG&G special projects which was right in McCarran Airport at that time.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft for the US government, describes how he got to work in 1988 and 1989: he drove to the offices of EG&G Special Projects, a defence contractor, located right at McCarran Airport in Las Vegas. From there, he says, unmarked flights known as Janet carried workers to Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in the Nevada desert. Lazar tells it himself to Michels as part of his account of his job.
